additional_production_change_review.source: Root formatted-v7 artifact, each complete file Git blob recomputed and matched to the exact remote compare SHA

findings.conclusion: This cohort does not add or install a concrete default current-memory provider; the prior default-owner gaps remain open in the reviewed composition.
evidence: state.rs:54-55 still holds OnceLock<Arc<dyn CurrentMemoryRetrievalContext>>; state.rs:160 still initializes it empty.
The only state.rs changes are inside start_canonical_intelligence (637-690); retrieval context initialization, the opened prompt owner and CognitiveStore attachment are unchanged.

config.rs is unchanged in the exact range: 279 defaults cognitive_retrieval_context to None; 642-658 requires explicit injection. runtime.rs is also unchanged: 94-97 enforces required-mode availability before owner startup, 164-170 attaches only an explicitly supplied provider.

Trait, cognitive_context, Lane C types, SQLite adapter/snapshot, prompt owners, compact owners and Engram source paths from the prior audit are absent from the changed-path inventory. No missing external currentness owner is supplied by the five production changes.

findings.conclusion: The configured canonical ingress now authenticates and preserves the original durable RunStart identity. It remains an explicit composition seam and does not install a default invocation provider.
evidence: state.rs:620-637 still requires both configured runner and provider; the missing pair returns Ok(None). state.rs:153-154 initializes those OnceLocks empty.
state.rs:642-645 checks the current original RunStart before provider.build and separates spawn/body generation from current lifecycle generation/fence.
state.rs:657 calls prepare_for_run_start; 670-685 revalidates and uses start_revalidated_run_start before attaching the exact context.
intelligence_ingress.rs:22-47 validates request/run/objective/authority plus original spawn/body versus current run generation/fence. Lines54-60 remain a trait contract.
config.rs:283-284 defaults both optional components to None; runtime.rs:154-162 only attaches explicit configuration; both files are unchanged.

The new concrete InvocationProvider appears at intelligence_canonical_runtime_test_support.rs:35-69 and stores a preconstructed Mutex<Option<AgentdIntelligenceInvocationV1>>. Lines347-357 install it explicitly into the test fixture. It is not a current production owner composition.

findings.conclusion: This cohort does not add a default durable Decision/Outcome owner or its cross-process publication/recovery path. The existing caller-owned qualification APIs must not be presented as that default wiring.
evidence: intelligence_product_runner.rs:296-407 keeps append_decision, append_outcome, append_event and reconcile_ledger_append behind qualification-legacy-learning-write. Each receives caller-owned &mut DurableLedger; append_event/reconcile call append_qualification.
The exact runner diff changes preparation and original RunStart projection/budget only. It does not alter these append/reconcile implementations or construct a LedgerWriter owner.
intelligence_canonical_runtime_test_support.rs:268-328 creates/reopens the real DurableRunStartJournal in the same process. That journal is the original admission record, not a default D/O writer.

The canonical owner fixture explicitly seeds the App Server readiness event at lines178-180. These new tests do not independently demonstrate real App Server/provider startup or process-loss D/O recovery.

findings.conclusion: The configured ingress now carries the exact original request/objective/body/artifact/authority/generation/fence/deadline identity through preparation and admission; remaining preparation time is capped by the original deadline. This is a concrete call-edge and failure-boundary repair.
evidence: intelligence_run_start.rs:12-30 projects the durable RunStart and validates its request identity before preparation.
intelligence_run_start.rs:37-61 checks the full frozen run and attachment tuple before coordinator mutation.
intelligence_run_start.rs:65-95 reuses RunSnapshot::from_run_start and caps the requested budget by the original remaining deadline.
lane_b_runtime.rs:67-100 centralizes the unchanged durable RunStart projection; start_revalidated_run_start at266-271 reuses it.

conclusion: Retain the original a640 full-search/28-source audit as immutable evidence. Add this fixed-range appendix: one audited source changed (state.rs), 27 audited sources are unchanged by the exact range, and the five production changes repair configured canonical ingress without closing default CurrentMemory, invocation-provider, or D/O-owner composition. No new-head global absence search is claimed.
scope_limit: The new head is assessed only through the exact ten-file delta, one refetched affected audit source, and hash-verified formatted production/test changes. This appendix does not relabel source review as activation, full-chain qualification, or a fresh complete-tree audit.
